records.price_basis: Current provider-owned Services & Fees page / Dental Health Clinic Fee Schedule
records.note: Pacific University's current live clinic page states that clinic fees use accepted ADA codes, are set by the clinic, and are updated yearly. The same live page contains conflicting schedule-age language ('accepted beginning January, 2024' and later 'Fees effective as of January 1, 2023'); registry conservatively uses 2023 as source_year and tags the record REFRESH rather than CURRENT. D0274 is individually listed at $30. The line 'D0210 FMX or D0330 PANO | $50' explicitly prices either coded imaging service at $50, so both D0210 and D0330 are entered at $50. The separately listed free Dental Exam has no explicit target CDT mapping and is not assigned to D0150. Current university clinic page independently confirms the fixed Hillsboro site, public patient care, current hours and phone.
